selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cup and not a similar vessel like a bowl or vase.
To verify the structural integrity of the handle connection and ensure the rim is a closed, continuous loop without melting or fusion artifacts.
To analyze the contact shadow and depth relationship between the cup and the blue fabric, ensuring the object is grounded and not floating.
To assess overall image quality, checking for subtle noise, blur, or texture inconsistencies in the ceramic glaze.

focus_areas: Handle attachment points (top and bottom) for fusion/melting artifacts.
Rim continuity and elliptical perspective correctness.
Contact shadow realism between cup base and fabric.
Surface texture consistency (glazed ceramic vs. plastic/smoothed AI noise).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the handle-to-body junction. AI generators often fail here by blending the handle into the body without a clear seam or by creating a physically impossible connection. Also, verify the elliptical shape of the rim; it should be a perfect ellipse given the camera angle, not a distorted polygon.
